title: Mindless theme suite: kit, website, Space page, Spotlight, email, /themes/mindless, and the Mindless Space on mindless.one

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-16: create the full theme kit for Mindless, find the Mindless Space and redesign everything, get the web theme ready to launch on mindless.one

detail:
Mindless is its own theme (id `mindless`, editor theme `Mindless`, tokens --ml-*): a meditation brand for loud lives, built from the Mindless Design System (Claude Design). Warm ink and bone, one paint accent (Yellow, Pink, Blue) and a small offset paint per section, Rubik Wet Paint drip display over Archivo, night first with a Day register (yellow is never text on Day: the accent phrase sits on a highlighter). Built in stages like CyberWitch (LIVE-2111), each its own PR, hidden from every picker until the last lands.

Stage 1: tokens (lib/theme/mindless.ts), skin and block sheet, faces (Rubik Wet Paint, Archivo; both OFL), registration in every theme table, theme contract, block-contract map, schema 2 dials (register, type) and three Looks. Stage 2: photos, six starter kits, manifest. Stage 3: Spotlight layouts and emails. Stage 4: design-system intake and /themes/mindless. Then the Mindless Space wears it and mindless.one is attached. Deviation: Pieces NFI (the logotype face) does not ship as a web font, its licence is unverified; the wordmark is the design's SVG.
